READ-ONLY task. Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa

I need a precise "base parity" comparison for a PDP change. Do NOT modify any file in the repo.

Compare these pairs and report ONLY genuine behavioural/visual deltas (not TypeScript annotations, not formatting, not comments):

PAIR A — the page:
  base:    node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-detail/index.jsx
  ours:    overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx

PAIR B — the view:
  base:    node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-view/index.jsx
  ours:    overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx

Specifically answer these questions with file:line + anchor text for every claim:

1. In base's page file, is there anything rendered between `<ProductView .../>` and `<InformationAccordion .../>`, or immediately after `<InformationAccordion />`, inside the non-set/non-bundle branch? Our version adds a `<ZimmProductMeta />` right after `<InformationAccordion product={product} />`. Confirm base has nothing there, and confirm the surrounding container (`<Island>`, `<Stack spacing={16}>`) has no spacing prop that would add a gap on top of ZimmProductMeta's own 28px paddingTop. Report the exact ancestor chain from ZimmProductMeta up to the page root, listing every spacing/gap/padding prop on each ancestor.

2. In base's `ProductViewHeader` (base product-view/index.jsx), enumerate EVERY child and its Skeleton wrapper with `isLoaded={...}` expression verbatim. Then enumerate the same for ours (overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx, the private `ProductViewHeader`). Confirm ours is a faithful port. Then list what our PAGE's `renderStaticProductHeader` (overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx around lines 720-780) does NOT reproduce from that base header. Be exhaustive: any prop, any wrapper, any conditional.

3. Does base's product-view render the header exactly twice (a mobile `display` block and a desktop one)? Confirm the `display` array values on each wrapper in BOTH base and ours, verbatim. Are they identical?

4. Is `isProductPartOfBundle` passed to the non-set/non-bundle `<ProductView>` in base's page file? And in ours? What is ProductView's default for it? (I believe our default is `isProductPartOfBundle = false` — verify and give the line.)

5. Does base's page destructure anything from `useIntl()` beyond `formatMessage`? Verify our addition of `formatNumber` is genuinely an addition.

6. Check `getPriceData` in node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/product-utils.js: under what conditions can it return an object whose `currentPrice` is undefined or 0 for a normal (non-set, non-bundle) product? Quote the relevant lines. This matters because our code maps a non-number currentPrice to the empty string.

7. Does base's product-view pass `name` to the header, and is base's title rendered as a template literal `{`${name}`}` (which stringifies undefined to the literal text "undefined")? Quote it.

Report findings as a compact list. Every claim needs file:line plus a short verbatim anchor. Flag anything that looks like a real regression from base separately at the top.

    57	                isRange={isRange}
    58	                {...listPriceProps}
    59	            />

    63	        <>
    64	            {renderCurrentPrice(isRange)} {isOnSale && renderListPrice(isRange)}

    66	    )

I have everything I need. Here is the comparison.

## Paths (absolute, referenced below by short label)

- `BASE_PAGE` = `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-detail/index.jsx`
- `OUR_PAGE` = `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx`
- `BASE_VIEW` = `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-view/index.jsx`
- `OUR_VIEW` = `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx`
- `PRODUCT_UTILS` = `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/product-utils.js`

---

# FLAGGED FIRST — probable real regressions

## R1. The 28px hop above `ZimmProductMeta` actually renders as 92px — `<Stack spacing={16}>`'s gap does reach it

The comment at `OUR_PAGE:916-921` ("`ZimmProductMeta`'s recipe owns both hops itself… A layout wrapper here would add its own spacing on top of that padding") is incomplete: **an existing ancestor already adds spacing on top of that padding.** Chain of evidence:

1. `Island` emits **no DOM element at all** in this app. `island/index.jsx:88-90`: `const isEnabled = getConfig()?.app?.partialHydrationEnabled ?? PARTIAL_HYDRATION_ENABLED` … `if (!isEnabled) { return <>{children}</> }`. `constants.js:266`: `export const PARTIAL_HYDRATION_ENABLED = false`, and `config/default.js:40`: `partialHydrationEnabled: false`.
2. So `ProductView`'s root `<Flex>` (`OUR_VIEW:683`), `InformationAccordion`'s root `<Stack direction="row" spacing={[0, 0, 0, 16]}>` (`information-accordion.jsx:25`), and `ZimmProductMeta`'s `<chakra.div>` (`zimmProductMeta/index.tsx:46`) are all **direct** DOM children of the page's `<Stack spacing={16}>` (`OUR_PAGE:802`) — i.e. direct flex items.
3. Chakra 2.7.0's `Stack` spaces with `gap`, not a child selector: `@chakra-ui/layout/dist/chunk-WKZT7ZXJ.mjs:72,77` — `display: "flex"` and `gap: hasDivider ? void 0 : spacing`. No `divider` is passed, so `gap: 16` applies.
4. Token `16` = `4rem` (64px): `@chakra-ui/theme/dist/chunk-G3IFUAY5.mjs:20` `16: "4rem"`; SFCC's `theme/foundations/space.js:7-9` only adds `11: '2.75rem'`; and `overrides/app/theme/index.ts:56,64` registers `space: spacing` through `extendTheme`, with `overrides/app/theme/foundation/spacing.ts:2` stating "Chakra's numeric defaults are preserved."
5. `zimmProductMeta.css.ts:31,44` — `const SPACE_META_ROW = '1.75rem'` … `paddingTop: SPACE_META_ROW`.

**⇒ accordions → model line = 64px gap + 28px paddingTop = 92px**, against the recipe docblock's Figma-sourced 28px (`zimmProductMeta.css.ts:12-15`). Note this is *not* fixed by the `display: contents` path either — if partial hydration were switched on, `island/index.jsx:200,216` `style={{display: 'contents'}}` generates no box, so children are still promoted to flex items of the same Stack, same 64px.

**Fairness caveat:** base already has this 64px between `ProductView` and `InformationAccordion` (same mechanism), so the gap itself is inherited base behaviour. What the diff introduces is a *third* flex item whose recipe was authored on the assumption that it owns the whole hop.

## R2. A product with no resolvable price renders "$0.00"; base renders no price

- `PRODUCT_UTILS:281` — `minPrice: res.minPrice === Infinity ? 0 : res.minPrice` (comment at :280: "when minPrice is infinity… we rest the value to 0").
- `productInfo.ts:58` — `price: typeof priceData?.currentPrice === 'number' ? formatPrice(priceData.currentPrice, currency) : ''`. `0` **is** a number → `formatPrice(0, …)` → `"$0.00"`.
- `zimmProductPrice/index.tsx:35` — `if (!price) return null` — but `"$0.00"` is truthy, so it renders.
- Base: `BASE_VIEW:86-89` — `<Skeleton isLoaded={priceData?.currentPrice}>` / `{priceData?.currentPrice && (<DisplayPrice priceData={priceData} currency={currency} />)}`. `0` is falsy → no `DisplayPrice`, and the Skeleton stays in its unloaded state. (Base quirk worth knowing: `0 && …` evaluates to `0`, which React renders as the literal text `0`.)
- Corollary: the `: ''` branch at `productInfo.ts:58` is **effectively dead on the header path**. `currentPrice === undefined` only when `product` is falsy (`PRODUCT_UTILS:247` `if (!product) return`), and that case already returned `null` one line earlier at `productInfo.ts:54` (`if (!product?.name) return null`). The case the empty string was meant to catch (no price) lands in the `formatPrice(0)` branch instead.

## R3. `DisplayPrice` is dropped entirely — range and sale-price semantics are lost

Base renders the component (`BASE_VIEW:88`); ours passes one pre-formatted string (`OUR_PAGE:767` `price={isProductPartOfBundle ? undefined : info.price}`). Not reproduced, from `display-price/index.jsx`:
- `:68-69` `if (isASet) { return renderCurrentPrice(true) }` — set range.
- `:72-73` `if (isMaster) { return renderPriceSet(isRange) }` — **master range ("From X"), the normal Zimmermann PDP case.**
- `:51-60` `renderListPrice` and `:64` `{renderCurrentPrice(isRange)} {isOnSale && renderListPrice(isRange)}` — struck-through list price on sale items.
- `:43-44` `price={currentPrice * quantity}` and `as="b"`; `:42` `labelForA11y`.

`getPriceData` computes `isOnSale` (`PRODUCT_UTILS:159`), `isRange` (`:165`), `listPrice` (`:144`), `tieredPrice`/`maxPrice` (`:167-168`) — all now discarded, since `productInfo.ts:28` narrows the input to `type PdpSourcePrice = { currentPrice?: number }`.

---

# Answers to the seven questions

### 1. Nothing between/after in base; the ancestor chain

**Base, non-set/non-bundle branch (`BASE_PAGE:787-810`) — confirmed empty.** `<ProductView … />` closes at `:807` (`showDeliveryOptions={storeLocatorEnabled}` at `:806`, `/>` at `:807`), `<InformationAccordion product={product} />` is `:808`, then `</Island>` `:809`, `</Fragment>` `:810`. No sibling between them and nothing after the accordion.

**Ancestor chain from `ZimmProductMeta` (`OUR_PAGE:922`) to page root**, every spacing/gap/padding prop:

| # | Node | file:line | spacing/gap/padding |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `<ZimmProductMeta modelInfo={…} styleCode={…} />` → `<chakra.div __css={styles.root} data-testid="product-meta">` | `OUR_PAGE:922`; `zimmProductMeta/index.tsx:46` | recipe root (`zimmProductMeta.css.ts:39-45`): `display: 'flex'`, `flexDirection: 'column'`, `alignItems: 'flex-start'`, `gap: SPACE_META_ROW`, `paddingTop: SPACE_META_ROW` (`= '1.75rem'`, `:31`) |
| 1 | `<Island hydrateOn={'visible'}>` | `OUR_PAGE:895` | **none — emits no DOM element** (`island/index.jsx:90` `return <>{children}</>`) |
| 2 | `<Fragment>` | `OUR_PAGE:894` | none (no DOM) |
| 3 | `<Stack spacing={16}>` | `OUR_PAGE:802` | **`display: flex`, `flexDirection: column`, `gap: 4rem` (64px)** ← see R1 |
| 4 | `<Box className="sf-product-detail-page" layerStyle="page" data-testid="product-details-page">` (page root) | `OUR_PAGE:787` | `layerStyles.js:32-40`: `px: [4, 4, 6, 6, 8]`, `paddingTop: [4, 4, 6, 6, 8]`, `paddingBottom: 32`, `width: '100%'`, `maxWidth: 'container.xxxl'`, `marginLeft: 'auto'`, `marginRight: 'auto'` |

So the answer to "has no spacing prop that would add a gap" is **no — `<Stack spacing={16}>` does add one.** `<Island>` is clean; the `Stack` is not.

### 2. Base header enumeration, our port, and what the page's `renderStaticProductHeader` drops

**Base `ProductViewHeader` (`BASE_VIEW:63-99`).** Container `:72` `<VStack mr={4} spacing={2} align="flex-start" marginBottom={[4, 4, 4, 0, 0]}>`. Children:

| Child | Skeleton wrapper, verbatim | line |
|---|---|---|
| `<Breadcrumb categories={category} />`, gated by `{category && (…)}` | `<Skeleton isLoaded={category} minWidth={64}>` | `:73-77` |
| `<Heading fontSize="2xl">{`${name}`}</Heading>` (preceded by `{/* Title */}`) | `<Skeleton isLoaded={name}>` | `:79-82` |
| `<DisplayPrice priceData={priceData} currency={currency} />`, inner gate `{priceData?.currentPrice && (…)}` | `<Skeleton isLoaded={priceData?.currentPrice}>` | `:86-90` |
| `<PromoCallout product={product} />`, inner gate `{product?.productPromotions && …}` | `<Skeleton isLoaded={product}>` | `:92-94` |

Last two are grouped in a single `<>…</>` behind `{!isProductPartOfBundle && (` at `:84`.

**Our `OUR_VIEW`'s private `ProductViewHeader` (`:193-225`) is a faithful port.** Same container `:202`, same four children with byte-identical `isLoaded` expressions: `isLoaded={category} minWidth={64}` `:204`; `isLoaded={name}` `:210` with `<Heading fontSize="2xl">{`${name}`}</Heading>` `:211`; `isLoaded={priceData?.currentPrice}` `:216`; `isLoaded={product}` `:220`; same `{!isProductPartOfBundle && (` at `:214`. Only non-behavioural deltas: `propTypes` blocks dropped for TS types (`OUR_VIEW:1057-1058` explains), and base's dead `showDeliveryOptions: PropTypes.bool` (`BASE_VIEW:108`, never destructured) is absent from `ProductViewHeaderProps` (`OUR_VIEW:110-117`).

**What `renderStaticProductHeader` (`OUR_PAGE:723-780`) does NOT reproduce:**

1. **The separate price Skeleton.** Base's `<Skeleton isLoaded={priceData?.currentPrice}>` (`BASE_VIEW:86`) has no counterpart — the price is folded inside the name's Skeleton (`OUR_PAGE:756`), so it loses its independent loading gate.

### 6. `getPriceData` → `currentPrice` `undefined` or `0`

`PRODUCT_UTILS:123-170`. `currentPrice` comes from `findLowestPrice` (`:131-135`):

**`undefined` when `product` is falsy** — `findLowestPrice` returns early: `:247` `if (!product) return`, so `?.minPrice` yields `undefined`. This is the ordinary PDP first render while `useProduct` is in flight.

**`0` when no price is resolvable** — `:281`:
```
// when minPrice is infinity, meaning there is no variant with lowest price found, we rest the value to 0 as minPrice to be able to use this value on UI
minPrice: res.minPrice === Infinity ? 0 : res.minPrice
```
`minPrice` stays `Infinity` because the reduce seed is `{minPrice: Infinity, …}` (`:276`) and the comparison is `:274` `return salePrice < prev.minPrice ? … : prev`, with `:267` `let salePrice = data.price`. For a **normal non-set, non-bundle product** that happens when:

- `isMaster` with `product.variants` an empty array — `:257` `const array = isMaster && product.variants ? product.variants : [product]`; `[]` is truthy, the reduce never runs → **0**.
- `isMaster` with variants present but none carrying a `price`.

Directly relevant to your concern: **`0` is a number**, so `productInfo.ts:58`'s `typeof priceData?.currentPrice === 'number'` test passes and the value is formatted, not blanked — see R2.
